_schema.description: Append-only LB_Anchor store for the poker-layered-tuning harness (Req 7.1, 8.7). Each anchor is a (configuration, real_leaderboard_score, measured_drift, holdout_AP) tuple from an ACTUALLY-submitted candidate. Used to calibrate the Drift_Gate (LB_Calibrated_Threshold) and the LB_Projection. APPEND ONLY: never edit or delete an existing anchor. Only a real, external leaderboard result may be added.

fields.config_id: stable identifier of the submitted configuration
fields.real_lb: the REAL private/public leaderboard score returned by Kaggle (external judge, never a projection)
fields.measured_drift: adversarial dev-vs-eval AUC (Drift_Gate) for the whole feature stack
fields.holdout_ap: PU-stress AP on the table-disjoint, pair-disjoint 40% dev holdout
fields.source: provenance / dossier section the anchor is grounded in
fields.verified: true only when confirmed by an external judge (leaderboard) per accountability contract Rule 1
